lesson: First card back after the international break. Every match today was priced on match odds, goals and BTTS. Most were fairly priced, so the card is two small bets and the full price board for everything else.

matches.analysis: Prices: 1.44 / 4.50 / 6.50. Over 2.5 1.80 / Under 2.5 2.00; BTTS Yes 2.00 / No 1.75. After checking match odds, goals and BTTS, nothing is priced far enough from a fair line to back. No bet. Asian handicap price was not available to us for this game.

Prices: Villa 2.62 / Draw 3.30 / Brentford 2.50. Over 2.5 1.73 / Under 2.5 2.10; BTTS Yes 1.55 / No 2.30. Over 2.5 ranges from 1.66 (BetMGM) to 1.88 (bet365), so shop for the best price and only take it at 1.80 or better. Two different goals models put Over 2.5 at 59% and 65 to 70%, against about 54% implied at 1.85. Villa's last game was a 3-2 win at Spurs and Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0, so both attacks are scoring. Match result is a near coin-flip (Brentford marginally ahead) so we take the goals market instead. Stake 2%.

Prices: Chelsea 1.67 / Draw 4.00 / Bournemouth 4.50 (Chelsea 1.74 to 1.87 at other firms). Over 2.5 1.50 / Under 2.5 2.62; BTTS Yes 1.50 / No 2.45. Asian handicap: Bournemouth +0.75 at about 1.90 (BetMGM). Chelsea have conceded the most goals in the league (12) and are winless in three, and Bournemouth have not been beaten heavily. This bet wins if Bournemouth win or draw, loses half if they lose by one goal, and loses in full only if Chelsea win by two or more. The edge is small, so the stake is small (1.5%). Over 2.5 at 1.50 and BTTS Yes at 1.50 are priced fairly, so we leave them.
